title: AI stocks rebound; S&P ends the week up 1.3%
detail: The S&P rose 1.6% on 27 Nov to 7,297 and 1.3% on the week, with the Nasdaq 100 up 2.6% on the day, after coming close to bear-market territory earlier in the week. VIX fell to 23.8 from 28.3. It is still ~6% down over a month.
implication: A relief bounce, not yet a trend change; AI financing worries and a near-certain Fed hike still cap upside.

title: Credit strain: SpaceX $32bn bond clears only at steep yields
detail: SpaceX's $32bn debt sale only cleared at steep yields during the sell-off. Gold had its worst week in ~8 months as investors sold to raise cash. Treasury Secretary Bessent warned the Fed against tightening too aggressively.
implication: The first sign the equity rout is reaching financing markets; AI-linked and high-yield borrowers are most exposed.

title: Fed hike in play as PCE hits 3.8% and Q3 GDP revised to 4.3%
detail: October PCE inflation rose to 3.8% y/y and core to 3.3% (from 3.1%). Q3 GDP was revised up to 4.3% annualised from 3.4%, and jobless claims fell to 189k. Markets had priced ~93% odds of a 25bp hike on 9 Dec; Waller floated 50bp.
countries: US TR ZA BR AR IN ID
implication: Hot inflation and strong growth lock in a December hike while equities are in a correction; a 50bp move is the tail risk for EM currencies.

title: Gulf attacks escalate: Saudi refineries hit, tankers struck near Hormuz
detail: The Houthis hit Saudi Arabia's Jazan refinery after a drone attack on Ras Tanura; tankers were struck around the Strait of Hormuz and Iran reported unverified mine strikes, though traffic has so far held up. Brent eased to ~$94 on 27 Nov but is still up on the week (from below $89 on 24 Nov). OPEC+ meets on 29 Nov and may hold quotas through January.
countries: SA JP KR IN CN TR IT EA
implication: The oil risk premium is back, with physical supply now being hit. Importers (JP, KR, IN, TR, IT) are most exposed, and tanker and energy names benefit.

title: France: Q3 GDP revised to −0.2% as PMI slumps; Germany booms
detail: Final Q3 GDP was revised down to −0.2% q/q (from −0.1%), with exports and investment falling; the November flash composite PMI was 46.2, the steepest contraction since May. November inflation eased to 2.9% (3.2% expected). Germany's composite PMI is 55.0, though unemployment holds at 6.4%, the highest since 2020. Australia's flash composite fell to 46.1.
implication: France is in technical recession territory; French assets and the OAT-Bund spread carry the risk. Softer French inflation gives the ECB less reason to hike.

title: Bank of Korea hikes to 3.25%
detail: The BoK raised its base rate 25bp to 3.25% at its last meeting of the year, despite the KOSPI sitting at a 10-month low on the chip rout.
implication: Another central bank tightening into a sell-off; the won and Korean chip stocks are the pressure points.

title: Australia: inflation 4.9% while jobs and PMI slump
detail: October CPI jumped to 4.9% y/y (4.7% expected; trimmed mean 3.8%) just as unemployment hit 4.9% and the flash composite PMI fell to 46.1, the weakest since Aug 2021. The RBA is at 4.85% after hiking in November.
implication: Classic stagflation squeeze: the RBA cannot ease into a slowdown. AUD, banks and housing-linked stocks carry the downside.

title: Reports US may raise tariffs on China and the EU
detail: Market reports on 24 Nov said the US may raise tariffs on China and the EU; no formal announcement yet. Separately, the US sanctioned more than two dozen Iranian exchange houses and front companies.
implication: A new tariff round would hit German, Italian and Chinese exporters and add to US inflation, complicating the Fed.

title: South Africa: inflation 5.2%; SARB split
detail: October CPI rose to 5.2% from 4.5%; SARB held at 7.25% with three of seven members voting to hike.
implication: A January hike is live; rand and local bonds are exposed.

title: Bank Indonesia surprises with a hike to 6%
detail: BI raised rates 25bp with inflation only 3.23% to defend the rupiah.
implication: Strong-dollar pressure is forcing EM central banks to tighten; watch IN, TR and ZA.

title: China October data miss
detail: Industrial production +4.8% y/y vs 5.3% expected; retail sales +0.4% vs 0.8%. Beijing has since rolled out measures to support the stock market.
implication: Weak China demand weighs on commodity exporters (AU, BR) and Korean suppliers.

title: Tokyo core CPI rises to 2.9%
detail: Tokyo November core CPI rose to 2.9% from 2.6% (headline 2.8%), after national October CPI of 2.3% and flat Q3 GDP.
implication: Keeps a December BoJ hike live with the yen near 159; a hike could trigger carry-trade unwinds.

title: Euro-area inflation 4.0%; Italy 5.5%
detail: Final October HICP confirmed at 4.0%; Italy's national CPI rose to 5.5%. Flash November CPI for France and Spain due this week.
implication: ECB hike bias persists while growth slows; periphery spreads widen first.

title: UK and Canada retail sales beat
detail: UK October +2.3% y/y vs 1.7% expected; Canada September +7.5%. UK consumer confidence improved to −22.

title: Baltic Dry steady near 2,900
detail: −2.8% on the week; still +8% on the month.

title: Spain snap election on 29 Nov
detail: A domestic political event; limited global spillover unless it unsettles periphery spreads.
